passive.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
passive.description: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.

primaryAbilities.name: Terrify
primaryAbilities.description: Fiddlesticks damaging enemies with spells while unseen or targeting an enemy with Terrify's activation strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: While unseen and out of combat or impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability Fears them for {{ fearduration }} second(s).

Active: Fear an enemy for {{ fearduration }} second(s) and deal {{ totalpercenthealthdamage }} current Health magic damage. If the target has recently been Feared by Fiddlesticks, instead deal {{ totalpercenthealthdamagefeared }} current Health magic damage.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Bountiful Harvest
primaryAbilities.description: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing {{ draindamagecalc }} magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus {{ percentfortooltip }}% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores {{ vamppercentage }}% of damage as Health.

If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Reap
primaryAbilities.description: Fiddlesticks slashes an area with its scythe, slowing all enemies hit and silencing enemies hit in the center of the slash.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Fiddlesticks unleashes dark magic, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ silenceduration }} seconds. Enemies in the center are also <status>Silenced</status> for the duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Crowstorm
primaryAbilities.description: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Fiddlesticks channels for {{ channeltime }} seconds, then teleports and unleashes a murder of crows, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allSpellRecords.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
allSpellRecords.summary: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by Scarecrow Effigies. When discovered by enemies, Effigies briefly impersonate Fiddlesticks. If Fiddlesticks does not move for 2 seconds, he will impersonate an Effigy. At level six Effigies reveal nearby wards for 6 seconds.

allSpellRecords.name: Bountiful Harvest
allSpellRecords.summary: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus [12 / 14.5 / 17 / 19.5 / 22]% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores [25 / 32.5 / 40 / 47.5 / 55]% of damage as Health.

If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.
